notes.title: New update: v. 2016041102
notes.notes:
Mainly improved visuals, but also a few minor tweaks and bug fixes:

 Shiny New graphics for the players.
 Renewed animations, for the new graphics.
 Show tips before starting a game.
 Exiting a match will take you to the game selection scene instead of the main menu.
 New background for the game and controller selection screen.
 Performance improvements
 Some cleanup, so the game has a smaller size now
 New command line option: "+allowtimecontrol". I'll let you guess what's the use of it...

I hope you enjoy the player's new graphics, although I have to admit that I'll miss the old ones a bit :)

By the way, the new trailer music is by my friend Sergeeo

notes.title: A shiny new release!
notes.notes:
After a few months without updates (sorry!) here's a new version with:

Improved visuals: Now the game fields are real 3D models which gives a better depth perception. 
Now you can choose AI difficulty: Easy, normal, hard
Enable/disable screen shake
Enable/disable gamepad vibration
Enable/disable screen bloom
Improved gameplay for Volleytron and Pittron
Changes "under the hood" that will allow to remap keyboard controls on a future update.
Bugs fixes (no more "getting into the wall under certain conditions")

I hope you enjoy the new look and improved gameplay (the new AI is better at being good... and not so good)

Thanks for playing!
